mode: Read-only development diagnosis; no threshold/representation/fixture tuning.
semantics: Post-retrieval read-only probes of actual model/claim-hash-bound index rows. Includes negative cosine values, current eligibility and exact-copy representative ranks, task/failure query views, primary/conclusion index views, best nonrequired competitors and selected/full packet state. Probe availability is counterfactual; it does not prove a guarded supplementary lookup or focused planner ran.

validation.diagnostics_off_on_and_previous_baseline: All 272 case rows retain every legacy field except elapsed timings. Includes non-timing telemetry. Existing per-record comparator passes.
validation.production_runtime_source: Unchanged. Only evaluator code and documentation changed.
validation.broader_tests: Remain skipped under user instruction; no broad crate/core/frontend suite or stress/reserved replay was run.

limitations: Exposed synthetic incidents and correlated question variants, not generalization, precision or real-agent quality evidence.

Primary/conclusion ranks describe filtered distinct semantic candidates. The actual focused identifier planner and its packet rollback are not traced; selected match reasons identify records added by those paths.
Failure-query vectors are diagnostic probes even when normal retrieval would skip the guarded failure lookup.
Best nonrequired competitors can be useful context; they are not automatically false positives.
Opt-in diagnostics adds query probes and index scans. Timing is captured before diagnostic collection but cache warming can affect later cases; these runs are not latency benchmarks.
